_rules: DO NOT INVENT PROGRAM TERMS. There is no agreed discount, commission or product allowance written down anywhere, so this page describes none. NEXT-PAGES §4: 'An ambassador page that describes a commission structure nobody agreed to is worse than a page that says applications open soon.' It is built around the roster and the brand, with the application as one clear CTA into contact.
_blocked: The roster itself — five real names, five handles, five 4:5 portraits — and the program terms. Names are BRACKETED. The homepage roster (HANDOFF §7b G) has the same five slots and fills from the same answer.
headline: The people who actually play them
lede: Creators, club pros and a few very good amateurs who put Lucky in the bag before anyone was paying attention. They get early access, they give honest notes, and some of them make the videos.

items.v: Applications open a few times a year. There is no follower threshold to clear.
The notes we want are the critical ones. A roster that only says nice things is worth nothing to anyone.
Five slots on the roster today, and they are not filled yet.

roster.headline: Five slots
roster.lede: These are real slots waiting on real people. The names below are brackets, not placeholders for names we already have — nobody appears on this page until they have agreed to be on it.

tbd.label: Needs confirming
tbd.text: who the five are — names, handles and a 4:5 portrait each.
tbd.ask: The same five slots sit on the homepage, so one answer fills both.

rows.title: Golfers, not audiences
rows.phBrief: 4:3. Two or three golfers on a course together, Lucky clubs visible but not staged. Shot wide, natural light, no product hero framing.
paras: The useful ambassador is someone who would have bought the club anyway. They play enough to notice when a sole grinds through turf differently, and they will say so when it doesn't.
That is genuinely most of the brief. We are not looking for a particular follower count or a posting schedule, and there is no script.

items: You play regularly, and you'd put these in the bag on merit.
You'll tell us what's wrong with a club as readily as what's right.
You're happy for your name and handle to appear on this page.

items.title: Write to us
items.body: Email support@luckygolf.com or use the contact page. Pick “The Trybe / ambassadors” from the list so it lands in the right place.

items.title: Tell us how you play
items.body: Where you play, how often, what's in the bag now. A handle if you post; it is not required.

items.title: We'll come back to you
items.body: Applications are looked at in batches rather than continuously, so a reply is not immediate.

tbd.label: Needs confirming
tbd.text: what the program gives and what it asks — discount, commission, product, or some combination — and how often applications actually open.
tbd.ask: None of it is written down yet, so this page describes none of it. A commission structure nobody has agreed to is worse on a page than an honest gap.

close.headline: Say hello
close.body: There's no form to fill in and no application window to wait for. Write, tell us how you play, and it gets read.
close.aside: No follower minimum. That part is settled.

moreAside: The roster portraits and the program terms are the two things standing between this page and a finished one.
